items.comments: This is a super cute home!  It's really tiny (I wouldn't stay there with more than 2 ppl) but very clean, cozy and sweetly decorated.  We appreciated the guest parking pass for street parking.   Our car was broken into but not damaged - just a good reminder that all neighborhoods have a level of risk.  I really appreciated the home security system and felt very safe in the apartment.  It's a super nice, quiet neighborhood with beautiful homes and a gorgeous lake view.  Sarah was very conscientious and communicative.  Would love to stay here again!

This place was awesome!!  It is quiet, cozy and perfectly close to all that you need.  Sarah and Luke were so sweet.   They house was very clean and Sarah and Luke even left a stuff in the fridge for us.
